title: Exos Component Catalog Entry
description: Uniform description of one Exos design-system component family, grounded in @exos/exos-theme-alpaca SCSS source. Consumed by the Exos UI agent (Copilot) and validated by the drift-check script.

element.description: Default HTML element/tag for the root, e.g. 'button'. Null when the component is purely a class applied to varied elements.

source.description: Provenance used by the drift-check script to verify every class still exists in the installed theme.

package.description: npm package the styles ship from.

scss.description: SCSS files (relative to the package root) that define this component's classes.

baseClass.description: Class(es) always required on the root element. Space-separated if more than one. Null when there is no single base class.

tokens.description: Informational map of design tokens this component honors (from tokens.json / _variables.scss). Not validated as classes.

a11y.description: Accessibility requirements the agent must satisfy.

axes.description: Variant dimensions. Each axis is independent; the agent picks one option per axis. Omit axes that don't apply.

type.description: 'class' = applied via CSS class; 'attribute' = applied via HTML attribute (e.g. disabled).

options.description: Map of option key -> definition. A null value means 'the default; add nothing'. A string means a literal class/attribute. An object allows patterns + provenance.

pattern.description: Class template with {color}/{tone}/etc. placeholders expanded by the sibling arrays.

origin.description: 'exos' = class must exist as a literal selector in source.scss. 'bootstrap' = class is generated by Bootstrap from the theme color map; drift-check validates the {color} against tokens.json instead.

structure.description: Child composition for composite components (card, modal, alert). Null for atoms.

examples.description: Curated, copy-pasteable real HTML using only design-system classes.

intent.description: When to reach for this example.

inference.description: Intent -> variant mapping. Lets the agent choose variants deterministically from prompt keywords instead of guessing.

slots.description: Class names of allowed direct children.
